adoption: Controller-implemented per MIXED-GRAPH-PLAN.json (24aab5fea3); provider r11 hit turns cap with a non-functional partial (archived).
description: SGLANG_SPLIT_DECODE_PREFILL=1 (opt-in): when a prefill (eager extend) batch is scheduled and decode rows are runnable, prepare_for_decode keeps the decode batch separate (no mix_with_running); the event loop runs it back-to-back after the prefill forward on the same stream, so decode replays its CUDA graph instead of idling during the 867ms prefill.
key_changes: Module-level strict flag parse (_parse_split_decode_prefill, single env read)
Scheduler guard: split_decode_prefill only in plain generation config (no spec/dp-attn/PP/disagg)
_get_new_batch_prefill_raw mix block: split path stores _split_decode_companion instead of mixing
event_loop_normal/overlap: _pop_split_decode_companion after prefill run_batch; overlap queues both results, pop_and_process drains
chunked prefill budget reserves decode rows under split (same as mixed chunking)
expected_effect: Recovers the 33.8% wall time that serialized prefill forwards steal from decode at C32 (attribution c32-stall-attribution-v1.json); per-user median should approach the 45.5 tok/s unstalled ceiling.
